access.fees: $5 per vehicle per day (or $30 annual) day-use fee at the trailhead
access.rules: Group size capped at 12 (people + stock combined) inside Glacier Peak Wilderness; larger groups must split with 1-mile separation. Campfires prohibited above 3,500 ft in wilderness.
access.permit: None required — free self-issue wilderness permits available at trailheads/ranger stations for day/overnight travel where the peak is inside designated wilderness.
access.closures: The ice caves and area directly below the North Face cliffs are permanently closed to entry due to rock/ice fall hazard
access.landManager: Mount Baker-Snoqualmie National Forest, Darrington Ranger District
access.land_manager: Mt. Baker-Snoqualmie National Forest (Darrington Ranger District)
access.parking_pass: Northwest Forest Pass required at Mountain Loop Highway trailheads — $5/day or $30/year.
access.passRequired: Northwest Forest Pass or Interagency Recreation Pass honored
